The home's layout is perfect for family gatherings or group getaways. Your stay includes 7 bikes, access to 2 pools seconds away, and a FREE beach tram to take you straight to the sugar-white sands in no time. Just steps from boutique shops, live music, and amazing dining, this home offers the ultimate mix of relaxation and adventure. Will definitely stay again." – Taylor P."Tons of space for our entire family, and the location couldn’t have been better." – Holly M."Beautiful home close to restaurants and beaches. The included bikes were a bonus!" – Erica W. *** LIVING AREAS ***Gather in the bright, spacious living room on the 2nd floor where relaxation meets coastal charm. Large windows flood the space with natural light, while plush seating and a Smart TV create the perfect spot for family movie nights or morning coffee. Step out onto the balcony to enjoy refreshing ocean breezes.Open-concept design with ample seatingSmart TV for entertainmentBalcony access with outdoor seating for enjoying fresh air*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***Cook and dine in style with the fully equipped gourmet kitchen and spacious dining area. Premium appliances make meal prep a breeze, while the large dining table accommodates the whole group for memorable meals.Modern kitchen with high-end appliances, including dripping and Keurig coffee makersSpacious dining table that comfortably seats 8, complemented by a breakfast bar with seating for 4Open layout for easy entertaining *** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***1st Floor:Bunk Nook: Custom Full-over-Full Bunk Bed (sleeps 4) at the entryQueens Bedroom: 2 Queen beds, smart TV and a private en-suite bathroom featuring a tub/shower combo2nd Floor:Bunk Room: Custom Twin-over-Twin bunk with an en-suite featuring a walk-in shower, smart TV3rd Floor:Primary Suite: King bed with a luxurious en-suite featuring a soaking tub and double vanity, smart TV King Guest Bedroom (Left): King bed with shared bathroom access, smart TV King Guest Bedroom (Right): Second King bed with shared bathroom access, smart TVFull Shared Bathroom: Dual Vanity with Tub & Shower Combo*** LOCATION, COMMUNITY & AMENITIES ***Nestled in the heart of Seacrest Beach, this home offers unbeatable access to local attractions and top-notch community amenities. Lounge at the beach, explore vibrant bike trails, or enjoy boutique shopping and dining just steps away at Peddler’s Pavilion. Relax at two community pools, including a zero-entry pool perfect for kids, or hop on the complimentary beach tram for a seamless trip to the shore. Take advantage of 7 provided bikes to explore the area and discover nearby shops, dining, and live music.Zero-entry pool and a second community pool with grills and outdoor seating for poolside BBQs steps awayPeddler’s Pavilion: Less than 2 minutesLocal dining and live music: Steps from your doorRosemary Beach: 9 minutesAlys Beach: 13 minutesFREE seasonal beach tram for easy access to the shoreHome to South Walton's tallest sand dunes*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW *** Travel Insurance is NOT included in quotes.
